info.title: Monocuco API
info.summary: Read-only access to Monocuco, the open dictionary of Barranquilla Spanish (español barranquillero).
info.description: Search and browse the words and expressions of Barranquilla Spanish, with their definitions in Spanish. No authentication. Every error is an RFC 9457 problem document (application/problem+json) with a stable `code` and a `hint`. Definitions and examples are Markdown. The whole dataset is also published as one file at https://monocuco.sjdonado.com/data.json.

get.summary: Search words, or browse them in dictionary order
get.description: With `q`, the words that match every term of the query, best match first (accents are ignored; ñ is kept). When nothing matches exactly, typo-tolerant results are returned with `approximate: true`. Without `q`, every word in Spanish dictionary order, optionally only those filed under `letter`. Pages are linked by `next` and `previous`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search terms, matched against the word and its definition. An empty value is the same as no q.

parameters.name: letter
parameters.description: Only words filed under this letter (leading punctuation and accents are ignored; Ñ is its own letter). Cannot be combined with q.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Page cursor: the id of a word in this result list; the page that holds it is returned. Use the `next` or `previous` URL of a response instead of building it.

get.summary: Get one word by its id

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The word's id, as returned by listWords.

example.description: Example of use, Markdown. May be empty.

url.description: The word's page on the website.

total.description: Words in the whole result, not only this page.

approximate.description: True when no word matched q exactly and the results are typo-tolerant matches.

detail.description: What went wrong with this request.

hint.description: How to change the request so it succeeds.

Problem.description: The request failed; the body says why and how to fix it.
